title: Clean LibreCAD master build and PR #3269 LTYPE regression slice
scope: Build the clean upstream LibreCAD master DWG/DXF fast-test target and run its focused named-LTYPE tests, including the merged changed-definition save/readback cases. This qualifies consumer behavior on LibreCAD's configured bundled libdxfrw, not a linked build against this upstream repository.

includedPr3269Cases: DXF writes a changed line type definition over its record
DWG writes a changed line type definition over its record
DXF writes a redefined built-in from the table
DXF writes a changed complex line type without its segments
DXF writes a twin archived spelling as it came beside a changed record

fixturePolicy.generatedTestData: The regression cases construct DXF input strings in test code; the DWG roundtrip is generated in the test temporary directory and removed by the test. No fixture files were added to LibreCAD or libdxfrw repositories.

limitations: The fast-test executable compiles and links LibreCAD's bundled libdxfrw subtree, not /Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw.
This does not prove LibreCAD source or binary compatibility when linked to the upstream libdxfrw checkout.
This does not qualify LibreCAD_3, ABI stability, Linux/Windows behavior, or independent DWG/DXF producer semantics.
The test selector exercises the relevant named-LTYPE regression neighborhood and the five PR #3269 cases; it is not the full LibreCAD test suite.
